project: Active Directory Service Desk least-privilege delegation
validatedOutcomes: Password reset of a separate test user succeeded under delegated rights.
Account unlock of a deliberately locked test user succeeded under delegated rights.
Force password change at next logon succeeded under delegated rights.
Attempt to disable the test account was denied with insufficient access rights.
Adding and removing a test user from GG-RDP-Allowed succeeded.
Attempt to add the test user to GG-Lab-Admins was denied with insufficient access rights.
limitations: Personal nonproduction lab only. No enterprise directory ownership, production change authority, privileged-access-management deployment, or organization-wide RBAC governance is claimed.
